title: Canonical dedup procedure reads identity_key-named files that no longer exist after UUID migration
description: The Canonical Signal Dedup-and-Write Procedure step 2 reads '.moeb/signals/catalogue/<identity_key>.signal.json' to check for existing signals. After the signal-catalogue-id-based-naming spec migrated all catalogue files to UUID-based filenames, no identity_key-named file will ever be found. As a result, every signal emission after the migration will create a new catalogue entry rather than incrementing an existing one, defeating deduplication. The spec noted that 'The identity key is retained as a deduplication tool written inside the record' but did not update the read step to search by a different mechanism.
proposed_resolution: Update step 2 of the Canonical Signal Dedup-and-Write Procedure in all three skill files: after failing to find '<identity_key>.signal.json', parse index.md for a row whose Title column matches the signal title (or scan catalogue files for a record whose title field matches). If found, use that record's signal_id to locate and update the UUID-named file. This restores deduplication without reverting to identity_key filenames.
resolution_summary: Superseded by a1000064: consolidated signal for signal lifecycle management process covering status transitions, dedup, and archive.
